notes: Sides: ~4 px inside the thin rule that runs inside the thick bar. The frame bows (left rule drifts ~9 px, right ~17 px, top ~12 px between ends), so points were set every ~250-500 px from the rule measured on full-resolution crops and pixel profiles. Corners (README rule 2): the outline runs ~3-4 px inside the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc, points every ~15-35 px, with a small step where each arc's end notch meets the side rule; arcs, corner triangles and everything between them and the corner are outside. At the top-left corner the hatched blocks along the top abut the thin arc and the top rule; the edge cuts them ~4 px below the arc/rule. Blocks along the top and left run right up to the rule; the edge goes through that map ink, never the rule. Holes (README rule 4): the rotated CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title, legend and scale block (left of the Market St diagonal; rectangle on open paper), the compass rose with its three long arrows (elongated outline on paper), and the SECTION 1 badge (bottom right; octagon clear of the arc). 'Join Sec. 2' prints above the top bar and the side note beyond the right bar, so both are already outside. Kept as map: BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, AQUATIC PARK, FERRY BUILDING and pier/street lettering.
drawn_by: Claude, by eye on full-resolution crops, 2026-11-20
